stories.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
stories.body: Israel's PM says its military will not pull out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

stories.title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
stories.body: Italy's culture minister says it is one of the most important underwater archaeological finds in years.

stories.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
stories.body: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread over 53 sq miles (136 sq km).

stories.title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
stories.body: Prosecutors accuse six others, including the leader of cartel Los Lobos, of having an indirect role in the murder of Fernando Villavicencio.

stories.title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
stories.body: Police are investigating a drone sighting over a miltary base reportedly used for housing Patriot missile system parts.

stories.title: Nigerian army says it safely rescued 33 people kidnapped by gunmen
stories.body: The people were abducted while travelling through the country's north-western Zamfara state on Saturday.

stories.title: Perez Hilton faces long recovery after reports he self-harmed during livestream
stories.body: The US blogger is in a "serious but stable" condition in hospital, according to his family.

stories.title: Puerto Rico rations water supplies due to intense drought
stories.body: Hot weather and ageing infrastructure have led to the rationing, affecting hundreds of thousands of people.

stories.title: An unbearable rotting stench is plaguing an LA neighbourhood
stories.body: Heaps of rotting meat have been festering in the summer sun after a fire ripped through a huge food warehouse.

stories.title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
stories.body: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations in historic, Palestinian areas of the West Bank.

stories.title: Man arrested after boat capsizes near Statue of Liberty killing woman and infant
stories.body: Twelve other people initially rescued from the water are all reported to be in stable condition.

stories.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
stories.body: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.

stories.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
stories.body: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.

stories.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
stories.body: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

stories.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
stories.body: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.

stories.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
stories.body: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".

stories.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
stories.body: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
stories.body: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

stories.title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
stories.body: The group moved synthetic drugs from Spain to Algeria, then used the return journey to smuggle migrants and weapons.

stories.title: Book hidden in fireplace returned to Australian library 150 years overdue
stories.body: It is thought an apprentice stonemason who worked on the Houses of Parliament in London borrowed it.
